name: Petromil Petkov
headline: Head of Innovation Hub Singapore @ Volkswagen Group | Corporate VC | INSEAD | CDTM | TUM
summary:
Valued senior manager with 12 years of experience in driving technology innovation and corporate venturing in complex technology and organisational environments. 

Demonstrated strong track record of winning technology partnerships based on deep understanding of technology innovation, solid business acumen, and strong negotiation skills with C-suite, middle management and technology experts.

Confident in navigating diverse cultures and stakeholder interests based on extensive experience across corporate, startup and research organisations in Singapore, China, India, Germany, USA, and Australia.

positions.title: Visiting Lecturer
positions.description: Visiting lecturer at INSEAD's MBA program, delivering specialized talks on corporate entrepreneurship, innovation, corporate venture capital, and startup partnerships based on my industry expertise.

positions.title: Head of Innovation Hub Singapore
positions.description:
Founded and scaled Innovation Hub Singapore with full strategic, P&L, and operational responsibilities. Successfully positioned the hub as the Group's key Asian technology testbed for deep tech solutions before scaling to core markets (Europe, USA, China).

Launched and led a multi-brand, Group-wide initiative to embed AI into sales and marketing processes. This culminated in a global AI pricing platform aimed to deliver $10M in annual opex savings across Volkswagen, Audi, Porsche, Skoda, and VW Commercial Vehicles.

Built high-value technology partnerships to secure technology expertise and co-development opportunities with startups, corporate labs, VCs and research institutes across Southeast Asia (e.g., TribeX-NVIDIA Accelerator, GenAI Fund, Continental-NTU Corporate Lab, National University of Singapore). Initiated and managed a multi-year AI research collaboration with AI Singapore. 

Shaped Group’s corporate venture capital strategy and served as the sole Asia-based core member for the creation and launch of the Group's first $350M VC fund, Leitmotif, focused on industrial decarbonization. Led the development of the investment thesis, branding scope, and provided strategic corporate venture capital advisory to the Executive Director of Group Innovation.

Elevated the Group's brand reputation as a keynote speaker and panelist on innovation, AI, and APAC technology trends at 15+ high-profile international and regional events by Fortune, Economist, CNBC, Economic Development Board of Singapore, Temasek, Vertex Ventures, INSEAD, among others.

positions.title: STAR Program Member & Advisor to Senior Leadership
positions.description: As an industry expert and thought leader, I was invited to serve on a select global advisory group for the Airbus Executive Committee ("STAR" Program), providing strategic advice focused on innovation, digital transformation, and operational excellence across the EMEA, Americas, and APAC regions.

positions.title: Venturing and Partnerships
positions.description:
Founded and led Fast Track - Volkswagen Group China's venture client platform and startup accelerator, focused on matching deep tech startups with critical brand needs from Volkswagen, Audi, Porsche, Skoda, and Scania. 

Evaluated 550+ startups through strategic partnerships with VCs and top universities, which resulted in 20+ partnerships in emerging business areas, such as autonomous driving, passenger drone transport, and automotive health.

Launched Scouting Forum, a cross-brand platform for middle and senior managers across all Group entities in China. This initiative successfully streamlined Group’s regional technology deal flow, startup evaluation, and collaboration strategies, reduced startup onboarding time by 40% and significantly strengthening ecosystem engagement, leading to 30+ partnerships with startups, VCs, corporates.

Led board-level strategic initiatives, including China 2035 strategic foresight, investment thesis for Group’s corporate venture capital activities in Mainland China, and mobility go-to-market approach for Southeast Asia.

positions.title: Innovation Management
positions.description:
Launched and managed Power Room, Audi China’s R&D technology incubator. Facilitated cross-functional teams in developing complex, future-forward concepts like vehicle-to-grid solutions and future seating concepts, regularly presenting these innovations directly to Audi's global board of management. 

Managed key digital innovation projects along their full development cycle from user research and concepts to scalable pilots, which were integrated into Audi’s leading infotainment platform - including a multi-screen digital experience, an interactive digital car manual and a hyper-localized navigation app.

Initiated and secured senior leadership sponsors for the first Audi App Challenge in partnership with Tsinghua University, establishing a platform for long-term academic collaboration and talent identification.

Nominated for a CEO-sponsored, high-potential program across the Group to develop new smart city mobility concepts.

company.name: INSEAD
company.tagline: The Business School for the World - Europe | Asia | Middle East | North America
company.description:
INSEAD is The Business School for the World. We bring together people, cultures and ideas to develop responsible leaders who transform business and society.

With locations in Europe (France), Asia (Singapore), the Middle East (Abu Dhabi), and now North America (San Francisco), INSEAD's business education and research spans four regions. Our 165 renowned Faculty members from 41 countries inspire more than 1,300 degree participants annually in our MBA, Global Executive MBA, Specialised Master’s degrees (Executive Master in Finance and Executive Master in Change) and PhD programmes. In addition, more than 11,000 executives participate in INSEAD Executive Education programmes each year.

INSEAD continues to conduct cutting-edge research and innovate across all our programmes. We provide business leaders with the knowledge and awareness to operate anywhere. Our core values drive academic excellence and serve the global community as The Business School for the World.
